family_reports.body: The system ripped my family apart. Broke our unity, our circle, caused major anxiety problems, behavior issues and cost the respect my oldest son had for me. He idolized me and now he doesnt respect me,he has been brainwashed my the system and his father whom they gave full custody to because of this last wrongful accusation. Has cause me so much emotional guilt and pain from not having my children with me,the pain of having your infants taken from your arms is the worst pain a mother can have. My children have separation issues and I have major PTSD even from the door being knocked on. It has destroyed our family.

Denied motion and ignored evidence!! None of them did their job they made up everything. The judge didn’t want to listen to us whatsoever that we gave him evidence and they didn’t show him any evidence and that he ruled with them over us. He delayed hearings gave them more time biased, he didn’t sign half of his records he had to click record sign it things like that you can put well. She really really wasn’t on our case that much it was mainly James he was the one he was his assistant prosecutor. They have kept me away from my daughter since she was born. Have false documents and have been proven but no one will listen to me. Please help me!!!!
This system has lied and tore my family apart causing emotional damage

My lived experience that is still ongoing has cast me into homelessness, taken all my belongings and created a situation that is impossible to regain stability even at its simplest form, and has attempted to silence my and my children’s stories from not just being heard but from the record entirely; it has cost me the most precious and valuable thing of all, my children, as well as my and my children’s protection, belief in justice, safety, healing, my children’s voices and their childhood at ages 7 & 11.

The system has destroyed my entire family and when I asked the corrupt judge greer to tell me why, he simply told me he don't have to explain why he made the decision to terminate my rights. Let that sink in....
They took the happiest and joy out of us

public_comments.comment_text: My children’s therapists and myself reached out to Mr Kirk from Oct 2024 to March 2025 with no return communication. He then made claims as facts, brought to him via an email from a concerned citizen, yet never spoke to myself or others to verify this concern. While communication was not provided to myself or the therapists, Mr Kirk kept communications with the defendant and his counsel. As of May 5 2026, he has been voted in to Higjland County’s Juvenike judge position set to take oath in November.

public_comments.comment_text: Mr kirk made no reasonable efforts to put my daughter back in my care, despite having long term housing and employment. He filed no motions with the court on my daughter's behalf. Never came to my house for a visit and I called his office early in the case to setup a home visit and he said that he doesn't complete home visits till after the adjudication and deposition. He is now taking Judge Greers position as the juvenile judge.
